notes: ἂν θέλοι is joined into one aligned unit on 'would' so that neither token is left empty against rule 50; giving 'would' to ἄν alone and leaving θέλοι unrepresented is named as the competing reading.
The δέ answering the οἱ μέν-like pair is unrepresented because the ASV writes no conjunction there (rule 70).
